- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided an overview of common adhesives used in art conservation, including acrylic polymers, animal glues, cellulose-based adhesives, epoxy resins, and natural waxes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed common consolidants, such as acrylic polymers, Paraloid B-72, Butvar B-98, Parylene, and silanes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained factors to consider when choosing adhesives and consolidants, including material composition, cultural significance, reversibility, and long-term aging.
